name.title: Garage Door Name
name.description: The name of your garage door as it will appear in HomeKit

ipAddress.title: IP Address
ipAddress.description: The IP address of your Raspberry Pi relay module

port.title: Port
port.description: The port number of your Raspberry Pi relay module

secret.title: Relay Secret
secret.description: The HMAC-SHA256 secret key for authenticating with the relay module API. This should match the RELAY_SECRET in your .env file on the Raspberry Pi.

gpioPin.title: GPIO Pin
gpioPin.description: The GPIO pin number connected to the relay module (default: 23)
